neighbours.label: ' able' in a question or condition about whether someone can do something ('am I able to', 'are you able to'), as against the same requests phrased with 'can' or 'allowed'
fire: Before I sign up, am I able to cancel at any time?
If you are able to speak Italian, the job is yours.
Where are we able to park during the festival?
My question is whether I will be able to travel in May.
Is she able to join the call later this afternoon?
Once you are able to walk again, start with short distances.
How soon am I able to return to work after surgery?
Hopefully they will be able to fix the roof before winter.
quiet: Before I sign up, can I cancel at any time?
If you speak Italian, the job is yours.
Where are we allowed to park during the festival?
My question is whether I can travel in May.
Can she join the call later this afternoon?
Once you can walk again, start with short distances.
How soon can I return to work after surgery?
Hopefully they will fix the roof before winter.

predictions: fire 0.3-0.5 on ' able' in 'am I able / are you able / be able'; 'can I', 'allowed' below 0.05
